title: ‘Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. & Carolyn Bessette’ Cast and Creator on Navigating Early Criticism and Finding Their JFK Jr. Among 1,000 Actors
summary: People were quick to critique the FX series about ’90s power couple JFK Jr. and Carolyn Bessette Kennedy, including JFK’s grandson Jack Schlossberg. “We got intense feedback," says EP Brad Simpson. Star Sarah Pidgeon adds, "I hope that they feel we led with respect and honor for John and Carolyn."
